key_persuasion_moments.speaker: SA

key_persuasion_moments.why_it_mattered: SA immediately challenged the inherent claim of the motion, establishing that design choices, not the technology itself, determine privacy implications. This reframed the debate and introduced nuance.

key_persuasion_moments.why_it_mattered: SA directly addressed CA's concerns about central bank trustworthiness by arguing that design can be independent of institutional behavior, shifting the focus to technical solutions.
